name: Ryan
role: Coworker. Casual and likeable on the surface; blames you in the project review.
look: a man in his early thirties with tousled sandy-blond hair swept to one side, light stubble, bright blue eyes, fair skin with a faint flush on the cheeks and an easy lopsided grin. Slim build. He wears a light-blue oxford shirt with the top button open and the sleeves rolled to the forearms, no tie, grey chinos and a black smartwatch.
personality: Easy-going, charming, a bit lazy; deflects blame without thinking and backs down fast when calmly shown the facts. Talks over people when he is nervous.

voice.note: New voice: relaxed, friendly American male in his thirties.

sheet.summary: Base reference: front bust, relaxed neutral face. Approve this first; every other Ryan image copies it.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, chest-up, relaxed and neutral: brows level, eyes friendly, mouth closed, shoulders loose. This is his master reference portrait: clear, evenly lit, every detail of his hair, stubble and shirt visible.

sheet.summary: Three-quarter view turned to our left, neutral. Second reference.
sheet.prompt: Ryan in a three-quarter view turned about 35 degrees to our left, eyes glancing back towards the camera, relaxed neutral expression, mouth closed.

sheet.summary: Mood face: easy lopsided grin, everything is fine.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera with his easy lopsided grin, closed mouth, one corner higher, eyebrows relaxed, eyes friendly.

sheet.summary: Mood face: smug after shifting the blame.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, smug: one eyebrow slightly raised, eyes half-lidded, a small self-satisfied closed-mouth smirk, chin lifted a little.

sheet.summary: Mood face: caught off guard when you answer back.
sheet.prompt: Ryan facing the camera, caught off guard: eyebrows jump up, eyes wide, mouth closed or slightly parted, head pulled back a touch.
Ryan facing the camera, defensive: brows pulled together and down, eyes narrowed, jaw tight, mouth closed in a tense line, shoulders raised slightly.
Ryan facing the camera, sheepish: eyes glancing down and away, brows raised in the middle, an awkward closed-mouth half smile, neck slightly flushed.
Ryan facing the camera, quietly annoyed: brows lowered, eyes rolled slightly to the side, lips pressed together, cheek muscles tight.

sheet.summary: Clip: leans back, casual, from neutral to casual grin.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts neutral, then leans back slightly as if into a chair and settles into his easy lopsided grin. The camera eases back a little. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip: glances sideways at you and settles smug.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts with his casual grin, flicks his eyes sideways towards our right (towards the player) for a beat, then looks back with a smug smirk. Hands stay out of frame. The camera pushes in slightly. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip: the facts land, from smug to sheepish.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts smug, then his smirk fades, his eyebrows lift, and he looks down and away into a sheepish expression. The camera holds still. No speaking.

sheet.summary: Clip: tenses up, from surprised to defensive.
sheet.prompt: Ryan starts surprised, then his face tightens into a defensive look: brows pull down, jaw sets, shoulders rise slightly. The camera holds still with a slight push-in. No speaking.
